periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45 to 60-degree diagonal tilt oriented downwards toward the midline of the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a high width-to-height ratio along the dominant axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward vertical extension creating a teardrop effect below the ocular focal point.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal gap between ears, approximately double the width of a single pinna region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded semicircular contour at the superior boundary of the pinnae.
